name: Wit of the Abandoned Guard Tower
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: One creature
Duration: 1 round per level
Saving Throw: Will half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Initially, the target takes 2d6 points of phrenic damage +1 point per caster level . In addition, the target is dazed for a 1d4 rounds. A successful save negates the daze effect. If the save is failed, the target cannot target you with an attack of any sort for the duration of the spell.
